---
title: "Database Downloads"
subtitle: Download links for the slim and clean SQLite databases
---

Each source has a **slim** database (the common schema plus quality-control flags)
and a **clean** database (the QC-passed end product). Both are published on this
repository's releases. The slim database comes in two versions (see below); the
site's pages read the flagged one.

## Slim databases

The slim database is published in two versions, both using the same filename
`<source>_slim.sqlite` (so keep them apart if you download both):

- **Flagged** (this multised-slim v0.1.0 release): the common schema plus all the
  quality-control and marking flags (`category`, `value_std`, `dup_flag`,
  `below_loq`, `fines_lt63`, and the rest). This is the version the site's pages
  read, so use these to reproduce the site.
- **Original** (each source's pilot release): the reshaped common schema before
  the flagging steps, kept as the upstream provenance.

All five share the common [DB Schema (Slim)](./db-schema-slim.qmd): the same seven
tables, differing only in a few source-specific columns.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Clean databases

The clean databases apply the slim flags: uncertain rows removed, units
harmonised, grain-size split into its own tables. See how they are built under
[Clean Databases](./clean-overview.qmd) and the [DB Schema (Clean)](./db-schema-clean.qmd).

| Source | File | Download |
|:-------|:-----|:---------|
| Mareano | `mareano_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/mareano_clean.sqlite) |
| Vannmiljø | `vannmiljo_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/vannmiljo_clean.sqlite) |
| ICES-DOME | `ices_dome_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/ices_dome_clean.sqlite) |
| MUDAB | `mudab_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/mudab_clean.sqlite) |
| 4Demon | `4demon_clean.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/multised-slim/releases/download/v0.1.0/4demon_clean.sqlite) |

: Clean databases {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[25,45,30]"}

::: {.callout-note}
Each file is a self-contained SQLite database. To reproduce this site, download
the **flagged** slim databases and the clean databases (the pages read the flag
columns). See the schema pages ([Slim](./db-schema-slim.qmd),
[Clean](./db-schema-clean.qmd)) for the table definitions and the per-source
column comparison.
:::
